comment: Modified condition/decision coverage for the safety subset.
`subset` is the list of files whose multi-condition decisions must all have independent pairs covered.
It is a *list* rather than a glob on purpose: 'the whole library' would include the simulation plant, the
tuning aids and the drivers, whose decisions are not safety-relevant and would drown the signal. Adding a
file here is a claim that its decisions decide whether the bridge is switched off in time, so each entry
carries `why`.
`min_multi_condition_decisions` per file and again for the subset is the vacuity guard: a file (or a subset)
with no multi-condition decision scores a perfect ratio while measuring nothing, and that must be red.
`excluded_tests` must name every test object that cannot join the instrumented link, with the reason. The
C ABI is declared without `extern "C"` in the tests that include <foc/api/...>, so their references are
C++-mangled names that the C translation units cannot satisfy (282 unresolved references otherwise). They
exercise the ABI, not the safety subset, so excluding them narrows the measurement without biasing it.
`run_filter` drops nothing today: with RESOURCES_PATH defined every case passes, and a red suite is reported
as a failure rather than silently skipped, because coverage of a failing program describes the wrong program.
`src/version.c` is in the C++ bucket on purpose: `include/foc/version.h` declares `foc_version_string` without
`extern "C"`, and the repository's own build hands the file to g++, which compiles a `.c` by suffix as C++.
Instrumenting it as C defines the unmangled symbol and leaves every caller unresolved, which is how this was
found. `src/api/foc_api.c` is the real C ABI and stays in the C bucket.
Measured on 2026-10-30, clang 18.1.3 (baseline before the two boundary pairs: protection.hpp 4 conditions /
1 missed, sm.cpp 2 conditions / 1 missed): protection.hpp 2 decisions (4 conditions), sm.cpp 1 decision
(2 conditions), limits.hpp and limits.cpp none. Six conditions in the whole subset is why the plan's
'>=' 90 %' threshold was replaced by per-decision 100 %.

excluded_tests.test_api_host_motor.cpp: C ABI from C++, declared without extern "C" in the test
excluded_tests.test_api_identification.cpp: C ABI from C++, declared without extern "C" in the test

excluded_tests.test_invariants.cpp: uses the same non-extern-C ABI declarations for its driver harness
excluded_tests.test_sil_api_equivalence.cpp: compares the ABI against the C++ API, so it needs the ABI

subset.why: the trip decisions: whether the bridge is switched off, and how far it is derated
the state machine: an illegal or out-of-range transition must not move the axis
the clamps between the controller and the modulator; single comparisons, so no decision here is multi-condition and the file is checked only for uncovered pairs
the same clamps out of line; same reason
